topic: Taking a consolidation loan and running the cards back up vs freezing the cards after consolidating (Kendrick vs Hilda)

scenes.narration: Consolidating card debt often ends with double the debt. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard with a chart of debt dropping then doubling, comic burst banner reads DOUBLE THE DEBT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kendrick and Hilda both owe fifteen thousand across four cards.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split clinic panel of man kendrick and woman hilda each holding four cards with a tag reading FIFTEEN THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both take a consolidation loan at eleven percent to pay them off.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a loan document reading FIFTEEN THOUSAND AT ELEVEN PERCENT, four cards showing zero balance, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Kendrick keeps the cards open in his wallet. Just in case.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man kendrick sliding four cards back into his wallet, a thought bubble reads JUST IN CASE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Vacations, dinners, and a new TV land on the empty cards.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man kendrick swiping cards for a beach trip, a restaurant, and a TV, balances climbing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two years later he owes the loan plus twelve thousand in new card debt.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a chart with two stacked bars reading LOAN and NEW CARD DEBT TWELVE THOUSAND, man kendrick sweating, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Twenty seven thousand total. Worse than where he started.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a clipboard reading TOTAL DEBT TWENTY SEVEN THOUSAND, a red down arrow, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Hilda freezes three cards in her app and cuts up two.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman hilda tapping FREEZE in a banking app, scissors cutting two cards, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She keeps one card for gas only and pays it in full monthly.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman hilda at a gas pump with one card, a statement reads PAID IN FULL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every dollar that used to feed the cards now feeds the loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an arrow of cash flowing from crossed out cards into a loan balance shrinking, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two years later, her loan is gone. Debt, zero.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman hilda holding a statement reading LOAN PAID, a tag reads DEBT ZERO, sparkles, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Consolidate, then freeze the cards. No refills. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading FREEZE THE CARDS, a healthy debt free chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
